title: rubus rivularis var. rigidatus
intro: Rubus rivularis var. rigidatus, commonly known as the Himalayan blackberry, is a variant of the Rubus rivularis plant species. It is a thorny shrub native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and fever, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rubus rivularis var. rigidatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
